item.powerarmor.power_armor.tooltip: Place it, right-click to climb in, Shift to climb out. Sneak + right-click an empty suit for its fuel, tool socket and Pack up.
item.powerarmor.suit_part.tooltip: Part of a Power Armor. Assemble it at a crafting table: arms beside the torso, legs below.
message.powerarmor.no_room: Not enough room to deploy the suit here
message.powerarmor.out_of_fuel: Out of fuel! Climb out (Shift), then sneak + right-click the suit to refuel.
gui.powerarmor.pack_up.tooltip: Turn the suit back into an item. Fuel and tool stay inside.
gui.powerarmor.socket_slot.hint: Power tools go here: Chaingun, EM Projector, Mining Drill, Chainsaw
gui.powerarmor.fuel_slot.hint: Firebox: coal 1:20, lava bucket 2:40, blaze rod 4:00 of walking. Tidal Engine on land: water buckets or bottles. Star Reactor: a Nether Star.
item.powerarmor.power_tool.stats: %s hearts per shot, %s fuel, every %s s
item.powerarmor.power_tool.install: Install it in a Power Armor's socket (sneak + right-click a parked suit). Hold use (right-click) with nothing to do in your hand to use it.
message.powerarmor.tool_on_foot: Too heavy to use on foot. Install it in a Power Armor's socket.
message.powerarmor.hand_unpowered: No power: the suit's hand won't move.
item.powerarmor.em_projector.tooltip: Power tool: hold use (right-click) to pull and hold items, mobs or players, release to throw them. Pulled items go into your inventory. Suits, bosses, iron golems, ravagers and wardens are too heavy: they are only pinned in place.
item.powerarmor.em_projector.stats: %s fuel per second while holding, %s per throw
death.attack.powerarmor.em_slam.player: %1$s was slammed into a wall by %2$s
death.attack.powerarmor.em_slam.item: %1$s was slammed into a wall by %2$s using %3$s
item.powerarmor.drill.tooltip: Power tool: hold use (right-click) to dig a 3x3 face. Diamond tip: digs stone, ores, obsidian, dirt, sand and gravel (not wood).
item.powerarmor.chainsaw.tooltip: Power tool: hold use (right-click) to cut wood and leaves. Cutting a tree's trunk fells everything above the cut.
powerarmor.configuration.coal_energy.too: Energy per coal or charcoal (1600 = 1:20 of walking).
powerarmor.configuration.lava_energy.too: Energy per lava bucket (the empty bucket stays in the fuel slot).
powerarmor.configuration.drain_idle.tool: Energy per tick while piloted and standing still.
powerarmor.configuration.drain_walk.tool: Energy per tick while walking (the unit everything else is measured in).
powerarmor.configuration.low_fuel.toolti: Below this much energy (fuel slot included) the suit warns: flashing gauge, beeps, dark smoke.
Energy per tick while pulling or holding something (1 = same as walking).
powerarmor.configuration.em_range.toolti: How far away (blocks) the beam can grab something.
Wall-slam damage per block/tick of speed above 0.5 (a full-speed throw: about 13).
powerarmor.configuration.drill_energy.to: Energy per block dug (20: a 3x3 face costs 180, about 9 faces per coal).
powerarmor.configuration.drill_pause.too: Ticks of pause after each 3x3 before the next one starts.
powerarmor.configuration.chainsaw_energy: Energy per block cut, felled logs included (15: a 5-log oak costs 75, about 20 oaks per coal).
powerarmor.configuration.chainsaw_max_lo: Biggest tree it fells in one go (logs).
powerarmor.configuration.chainsaw_logs_p: How fast a tree comes down (logs per tick).
powerarmor.configuration.title: Power Armor balance
item.powerarmor.chaingun.tooltip: Power tool: tap for heavy single shots, hold and the barrels spin up into a barrage. Each bullet is an iron nugget from your inventory.
item.powerarmor.chaingun.stats: %s hearts per heavy shot, %s per barrage bullet, up to %s a second; %s fuel per bullet
message.powerarmor.no_bullets: Out of bullets: the chaingun needs iron nuggets in your inventory or loaded into the suit.
powerarmor.configuration.chaingun_energy: Energy per bullet (each bullet also takes an iron nugget).
powerarmor.configuration.chaingun_spin_e: Energy per tick while the trigger is held and the barrels spin (walking burns 1).
powerarmor.configuration.chaingun_slow_i: Ticks between shots with the barrels at rest (the first shot of a burst, or tapping).
powerarmor.configuration.chaingun_fast_i: Ticks between shots at full spin (2 = 10 bullets per second).
powerarmor.configuration.chaingun_spin_u: Ticks of holding the trigger to reach full spin.
powerarmor.configuration.chaingun_damage: Damage per bullet with the barrels at rest (2 = one heart).
Damage per bullet at full spin. Bullets ignore the half-second hit immunity, so every one counts.
powerarmor.configuration.chaingun_overhe: Barrels heat up: after overheat_shots bullets without a pause the gun must cool down before it fires again.
Bullets in a row (without letting go) until the barrels overheat.
powerarmor.configuration.chaingun_cool_t: Ticks for fully hot barrels to cool down (starts once the gun stops firing).
powerarmor.configuration.seal_energy_per: Sealed suit: fire, frost, magma, cactus and effect damage cost this much energy per point of damage instead of hurting the suit (only while powered; lava still hurts the hull). 20 = a second of walking per point.
powerarmor.configuration.seal_effect_ene: Energy to keep one harmful effect (poison, wither, slowness...) away from the pilot. Good effects still get through.
powerarmor.configuration.air_energy_per_: Extra energy per tick while the pilot's head is under water: the suit feeds them air.
powerarmor.configuration.melee_bonus.too: Extra melee damage for the pilot's hand, with or without a weapon (2 = one heart).
Landings from at least this high (blocks) hurt everything around (a jump on flat ground is ~2.3).
powerarmor.configuration.stomp_damage_pe: Stomp damage per block fallen, at the centre (half of it at the edge of the shock wave).
powerarmor.configuration.stomp_max_damag: Most damage a stomp can do.
powerarmor.configuration.lightning_stun_: A lightning strike knocks the suit out for this many ticks (sparks, slump), then it restarts.
powerarmor.configuration.smash_blocks.to: Walking breaks leaves, panes, cobwebs, snow layers (block tag powerarmor:suit_smashes_walking); sprinting also breaks glass and ice (powerarmor:suit_smashes_sprinting). Nothing drops.
message.powerarmor.sealed_in: Sealed in: climb out (Shift) to eat or drink.
powerarmor.configuration.nugget_store_ma: Most iron nuggets a suit's hidden ammo store holds (right-click the suit with nuggets to load it). The chaingun uses it: the machine mind always, a pilot after the nuggets in their own inventory.
powerarmor.configuration.guard_range.too: A friendly suit with a chaingun shoots monsters within this many blocks of its owner (or of itself).
message.powerarmor.nuggets_full: The suit's nugget store is full (%s)
powerarmor.configuration.em_guard_radius: A friendly suit with an EM projector guards this many blocks around its home: monsters inside get flung.
powerarmor.configuration.em_guard_launch: How hard the guarding mind flings a monster, blocks per second (straight up: 44 = ~24 blocks high, enough for the fall to kill a zombie; a pilot's throws are 32). Creepers are thrown away from home instead.
powerarmor.configuration.work_radius.too: How far from home a friendly suit's drill (an open hall at home level, 3 blocks high) and chainsaw (natural trees) work, in blocks. Keep it under 32: allays only see dropped items within 32 blocks.
powerarmor.configuration.rogue_spawn_cha: Rogue suits: once per in-game day (like the wandering trader) this is the chance that one turns up 48-64 blocks from a random player in the overworld (only one at a time, not on peaceful). 0.02 = about once in 50 days. 0 = never.
A rogue suit leaves after this many ticks (24000 = an in-game day), as soon as no player is within 64 blocks to watch it go.
message.powerarmor.rogue_rebooted: The rogue suit's mind rebooted: it's friendly now. Climb in to claim it.
item.powerarmor.suit_helmet.tooltip: Put it on a Power Armor: right-click the suit with it, or use the helmet slot in its menu. It seals the suit (fire, frost, poison, air under water) and the suit's machine mind only runs with it on.
gui.powerarmor.helmet_slot.hint: Seals the suit and lets its machine mind run while you're out. Without it the suit only runs with you inside, unsealed.
item.powerarmor.firebox.tooltip: Suit engine: burns coal, lava and blaze rods. Floods and dies when water covers it.
item.powerarmor.tidal_engine.tooltip: Suit engine: runs free while wet (under water or in rain). On land it drinks water buckets or bottles from the fuel slot.
item.powerarmor.star_reactor.tooltip: Suit engine: with a Nether Star in the fuel slot it runs forever, tools included.
message.powerarmor.flooded: The firebox is flooded! Get it out of the water, or swap in a Tidal Engine.
message.powerarmor.flooded_pack: Can't pack up a flooded suit: drain the water or swap the engine first.
message.powerarmor.tidal_dry: The tidal engine ran dry. Get back in the water, or give it water buckets.
message.powerarmor.no_engine: No engine! Climb out and put one in the engine slot.
gui.powerarmor.engine_slot.hint: The backpack: Firebox (burns fuel), Tidal Engine (free while wet) or Star Reactor (a Nether Star, forever).
powerarmor.configuration.water_bucket_en: Tidal engine: energy per water bucket, used only out of the water (300 = 15 s of walking; the bucket stays).
powerarmor.configuration.water_bottle_en: Tidal engine: energy per water bottle (the glass bottle stays).
powerarmor.configuration.tidal_dry_grace: Tidal engine: ticks it keeps running free after leaving the water (a shoreline mustn't flicker it).
tooltip.powerarmor.tidal_fuel: Tidal Engine on land: %s of walking
